papers.title: Functional neurological disorder, suggestion and virtual reality: neuroanatomical and computational perspectives.
papers.reason: The paper relates attention and cognitive control in functional symptoms to predictive coding, cortical feedback, signal routing, and attractor dynamics, although it is a theoretical opinion rather than a formal model.

papers.title: Spatial Hearing in Individuals With Unilateral Peripheral Vestibular Disorders: An Exploratory Study.
papers.reason: The title indicates a study of spatial hearing and vestibular dysfunction without an evident focus on executive function, cognitive modelling, or cognitive-impairment assessment.

papers.title: Transdiagnostic symptoms and the masking of neurocognitive impairment across the early stages of psychosis.
papers.reason: The paper concerns clinical neurocognitive impairment in early psychosis, but the available information does not identify executive-function mechanisms, computational modelling, or digital biomarkers.

papers.title: Revascularization of Asymptomatic Carotid Artery Stenosis: Cognitive Results of the CREST-2 Randomized Trials.
papers.reason: This appears to evaluate general cognitive outcomes following carotid revascularization without a stated focus on executive-function mechanisms or computational assessment.

papers.title: Joint association of postoperative visual acuity status and baseline loneliness with cognitive impairment after cataract surgery in older adults: a retrospective cohort study
papers.reason: The study predicts broad MoCA-defined cognitive impairment from visual acuity and loneliness but does not investigate executive processes or process-based cognitive biomarkers.

papers.title: Brain perivascular diffusion and cognitive impairment in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
papers.reason: The study links a diffusion-imaging marker to cognitive performance and reports impairments in attention and visuospatial/executive function, but its principal significant imaging associations concern global cognition and delayed recall.

papers.title: Relationship between orthostatic hypotension, internal carotid artery blood flow, and cognition in patients with cervical spinal cord injury
papers.reason: The study associates cerebral blood-flow reduction with global cognitive screening scores, while corrected domain findings are limited to language and visuospatial construction rather than executive function.

papers.title: Eye-tracking and cognitive patterns in post-traumatic stress disorder: a scoping review
papers.reason: This review directly synthesizes eye-tracking and multimodal measures of attention, inhibition, and executive control in PTSD, providing candidate behavioural biomarkers despite not presenting a new classifier.

papers.title: Mentally transformed representations in memory are linked to their originals
papers.reason: Multivariate EEG decoding reveals how attentional selection jointly governs original and transformed representations in working memory, offering a direct mechanistic constraint for computational models.
